title: Hertz Car Sales Introduces 100K Mile Protection, Raising the Bar for Confidence in Used Vehicle Ownership
summary: With Americans keeping vehicles longer than ever and seeking greater reliability and protection from unexpected repair costs, Hertz Car Sales today introduced 100K Mile Protection.
body_markdown:
*New 3-Year/100,000-Mile Powertrain Limited Warranty comes at no additional cost to give used-vehicle buyers greater peace of mind*


ESTERO, Fla., August 25, 2026 – With Americans keeping vehicles longer than ever and seeking greater reliability and protection from unexpected repair costs, **[Hertz Car Sales](https://www.hertzcarsales.com/)**


today introduced 100K Mile Protection. This industry-leading protection includes a 3-Year/100,000-Mile Powertrain Limited Warranty on eligible vehicles at no additional charge and offers substantially longer coverage than the standard warranties offered by many leading competitors*. Combined with one of the largest selections of single-owner, near-new vehicles in the U.S. used retail market, with inventory typically one year old or newer, 100K Mile Protection reinforces Hertz Car Sales’ commitment to quality, reliability and affordability.


**Providing Reassurance Against Rising Maintenance Costs** Industry data shows the average age of vehicles on U.S. roads has reached a record 12.8 years, while **AAA** estimates the average cost of owning and operating a vehicle exceeds $11,500 annually. Research commissioned by Hertz Car Sales found that 79% of buyers say maintenance costs are an important factor when purchasing a vehicle, highlighting the growing focus on long-term ownership expenses and reliability**.


The study also found that trust in a dealership more than doubled when consumers learned it was Hertz Car Sales, increasing from 35% for a typical used-car dealer to 72% for Hertz Car Sales. This significant trust advantage underscores the strength of the Hertz brand in a category where confidence and reliability remain critical considerations for vehicle buying decisions. Building on that trust and consumer need, Hertz Car Sales is introducing 100K Mile Protection to help give customers greater assurance throughout the ownership experience.


**Maximizing Protection with “Near-New” Vehicles** Through its on-lot inventory and **[Rent2Buy®](https://www.hertzcarsales.com/rent2buy.htm)** program, Hertz Car Sales offers one of the largest selections of single-owner, near-new vehicles in the U.S. used retail market. With inventory typically one year old or newer, customers can access newer vehicles at used-car prices while benefiting from vehicles that have been regularly maintained throughout their lifecycle. Many eligible vehicles may still have remaining manufacturer warranty coverage, giving customers an additional layer of protection beyond Hertz Car Sales’ included 3-Year/100,000-Mile Powertrain Limited Warranty.


“Consumers are keeping vehicles longer and placing greater importance on reliability, protection and long-term value,” said Jeff Adams, Executive Vice President of Hertz Car Sales. “100K Mile Protection reflects our commitment to helping customers buy and own their next vehicle with greater confidence. Combined with our large selection of single-owner, near-new vehicles that are typically one year old or newer, it gives customers added peace of mind from the day they purchase and throughout their ownership journey.”


**Program Terms and Additional Benefits** Available on eligible vehicles, generally defined as those that are five model years old or newer with fewer than 75,000 miles at the time of sale, the warranty provides coverage for specified major powertrain components. Covered areas include specified components of the engine, transmission/transaxle, and drive axle. A $100 deductible applies per covered repair visit.


Coverage begins on the effective date listed in the customer’s warranty agreement and continues for up to 36 months or until the vehicle reaches 100,000 total odometer miles, whichever occurs first. The warranty is non-transferable to subsequent owners.


For certain covered mechanical breakdowns, customers may also be eligible for additional complimentary benefits, subject to terms, limits, and eligibility requirements:


- Rental car reimbursement
- Towing reimbursement
- Travel breakdown reimbursement


100K Mile Protection builds on Hertz Car Sales’ broader commitment to affordable vehicles, easy financing and a more confident ownership experience. Through its nationwide retail network, online shopping and buying capabilities, digital financing tools and Rent2Buy program, Hertz Car Sales provides multiple convenient pathways to help customers find, finance and purchase the vehicle that best meets their needs.


For complete warranty details, exclusions, and terms and conditions, customers can visit **[HertzCarSales.com](https://www.hertzcarsales.com/)**


.


*** *Available for eligible vehicles. Additional terms and exclusions apply. Competitive claim is b* *ased* *on the Company’s review of publicly available warranty information from major national used-vehicle retailers.* ***Source: Hertz Car Sales consumer research and market analysis, 2026.*

Through its extensive retail network and convenient online platform, Hertz Car Sales’ commitment to quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction means no hidden fees, detailed vehicle histories and straightforward pricing. Vehicles undergo comprehensive inspections and maintenance, ensuring customers purchase reliable vehicles they can trust. Learn more at **[hertzcarsales.com](https://www.hertzcarsales.com/)**
